notes:
AE notes: mid-market support SaaS (multi-tenant) focusing on faster agent throughput and lower handle time. Primary product team: "ConciERGE" platform (ticket + live chat).

POC ask: Hosted API POC first — must demonstrate streaming latency and reliable function-calling to backend CRM and internal tools. Hard SLO: <1.5s first-token for conversational agent in US region (95p during 9am-6pm PST).

Workload profile: ~200 concurrent agents during peak, 5k-12k conversations/day, average session length 6-10 messages, typical context window 1-2k tokens. Tool-calls: user lookup + ticket fetch + external knowledge search (~2 calls per turn).

Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models but will accept verified hosted variants if latency/cost tradeoffs are clear. Wants fallback routing: small/fast model for cold queries, larger model for complex escalations. Needs function-calling for structured API responses to populate UI.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; care about per-token unit economics and burst pricing. Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching, caching).

Security/compliance: must have SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration. Data residency for EU customers is a must in roadmap. Legal flagged terms around data retention and deletion.

Quotes: "If streaming can't hit <1.5s first-byte we can't replace our current provider for live chat" — Head of Product.

POC plan agreed: 2-week hosted POC in us-west, ingress from their agent UI (sample traffic). Objectives: 1) achieve first-token <1.5s at 95p for 200 concurrent agents, 2) validate function-calls to CRM and knowledge search with <350ms external call latency, 3) gather cost metrics (tokens/session, tokens/month) and quality comparisons.

Next immediate tasks: SE to share load-test harness + sample traffic generator; AE to send pricing tier and Dedicated baseline for 200 concurrent. Security to receive completed questionnaire responses 3/10. Finance to prep draft contract for Dedicated commit if POC meets SLOs.

Short-hand CRM fragments: "POC kickoff pending — calendar hold 3/15-3/29", "Need staging API keys + streaming demo snippet", "Ask: include function-calling JSON schema example".
summary: Mid-market SaaS (support chat) evaluating Hosted API POC focused on streaming latency (<1.5s first-token SLO), function-calling, then potential Dedicated commitment if SLOs and pricing acceptable. Security and SAML are primary blockers.
